_labels.geometry: CONFIRMED: HF config.json (docs/models/glm-5.3-flash.md, retrieved 2026-10-01) and tensor shapes in llama.cpp src/models/glm5-next.cpp:60-155 @ec7630a
_labels.dense_params: PROVISIONAL: summed from the tensor shapes in glm5-next.cpp @ec7630a (norms and biases below 0.01% ignored); total with routed experts and vision = 321.3B, matching the 321.3B in llama.cpp PR #27754 as quoted in docs/prompts/GLM53-TZ.md
_labels.attention.linear.state_bytes: PROVISIONAL: 64 heads x 128 x 128 fp32 state + 3 short-conv states (8192 ch x 3 x fp32), as llama.cpp keeps them
_labels.attention.indexed: PROVISIONAL from glm5-next.cpp:320-345 @ec7630a: decode gathers kpool*min(n_pool, top_k/kpool) + (kpool-1) = 2051 latents of 512; the indexer scans one pooled 128-dim f16 key per pool of 4 (pool_cells); aux = per-token f16 indexer key + pooled key share
_labels.native_context: UNKNOWN here; Z.ai announcement reports 1M (web search 2026-10-09, see research/R1-models.md)
_labels.kv_heads: KDA state is per head (64, divisible under TP); the MLA latent (512) and the indexer key are shared by all heads (1, replicated under TP) - adversarial review item 6
_labels.kv_store_note: llama.cpp stores key|gate|pooled (3x128) per token and 12 DSA layers incl. MTP (src/llama-memory-hybrid-idx.cpp:56-58 @79e2e74, research/R1 §3): up to ~8 GB at 262K vs ~3.75 GiB here (review item 14)
